aliasPolicy: Miss Dashwood at 9:9 is Marianne; other reviewed singular occurrences are Elinor.
London Mrs. Dashwood exceptions identify Fanny; other singular occurrences identify Henry’s wife.
Mrs. Ferrars in chapter 47 is Lucy; omit chapter 48 because the dialogue sustains a misunderstanding; other occurrences are the mother.
Miss Steele is Anne/Nancy except chapter 47, where it explicitly means Lucy. Omit 21:9, where modern-en says “One Miss Steele” without identifying the sister.
Eliza in 31:23 and chapter 46 is the elder; later chapter 31 references and chapters 44/47 refer to her daughter. Mrs. Brandon is the elder in chapter 31 and Marianne in chapter 50.
Bare John, Mr. Dashwood and Mr. Ferrars are deliberately omitted; the latter can leak the mistaken groom’s identity in chapter 47.
Coordinates use live chapters 1–50 and zero-based paragraphs, shared by the aligned editions.
